symptom: A modified local report replayed as success; a mid-run audit failure lacked an explicit uncertainty signal.
root_cause: Request identity and run status were checked but report bytes were not bound to a completion audit; incomplete execution metadata was too weak.
fix: Audit the exact output digest, verify it on replay, and retain interrupted markers with outcome_uncertain so no uncertain job auto-reexecutes.
prevention_rule: Completion needs independently persisted output-integrity evidence. A timeout/audit error is not proof no attempt occurred; reconcile markers before retry.

impact.scope: Disposable local fixtures only; no provider/customer/financial action
